results.name: Solar consistency
results.label: Unverifiable
results.explanation: At the place and time recorded in the file (2025-06-21 13:50, time zone from the EXIF offset), the sun was 65° above the horizon, toward the south (179°): full daylight. Outdoor shadows should point north, about 0.5 times as long as the object is tall. Compare this with the photo: say whether it shows day, twilight or night, and Tala X will check that it is physically possible.

results.name: Editing software
results.label: To check
results.explanation: The file was saved by an image editor: Adobe Photoshop 26.0. Editing is often legitimate (cropping, exposure), but the image is no longer exactly what the camera produced.

results.name: C2PA Content Credentials
results.label: Unverifiable
results.explanation: The file carries no Content Credentials (C2PA). Most cameras and phones do not produce them and platforms remove them, so their absence says nothing about the image.

disclaimer: Tala X never certifies that an image is authentic. It reports what can honestly be said about a file. An original camera file is not proof that its content is true: metadata can be forged by anyone who knows how. Tala X is built against platform laundering and recycled images, not against expert forgers.
